title: Characteristic functions of two meromorphic functions weakly sharing three small functions with bi-weights
summary: Two meromorphic functions $f$ and $g$ are said to weakly share a small function $a$ with bi-weight $(n,k)$ if the functions $f-a$ and $g-a$ have the same zeros with multiplicities truncated at level $n+1$, while zeros whose multiplicities exceed $k$ are disregarded.
